line: Crowley's Atu III: the letter Daleth, Venus, and the path that unites Chokmah with Binah.

sections.title: What the card is, and its path
sections.line: The letter Daleth and the planet Venus; Daleth is the path from Chokmah to Binah, which the Key Scale gives as path 14.

quotes.quote: This card is attributed to the letter Daleth, which means a door, and it refers to the planet Venus.
On the Tree of Life, Daleth is the path leading from Chokmah to Binah, uniting the Father with the Mother.

sections.title: What the card figures
sections.line: Crowley's account of the card's doctrine and of the figure's combination of qualities.

quotes.quote: The doctrine implied is that the fundamental formula of the Universe is Love.
She combines the highest spiritual with the lowest material qualities.
